D5F4 immunohistochemistry is the most sensitive assay for detecting ALK expression, and that ALK genomic amplifications and hotspot mutations are not detected in the majority of ALK-positive neuroblastoma cases.
ALK protein immunohistochemical expression, genomic copy number, and hotspot mutation status are all important in neuroblastoma.

the ALK protein expression status is a very poor predictor for ALK genomic amplifications and hotspot mutations.
